meta.title: European Conference Funding for Graduate Students
meta.scope: Only actual conferences in Europe with verified graduate-student funding routes where an accepted paper is not mandatory.
meta.disclaimer: This is a verified tracker, not a guarantee of funding. Calls change each year; always confirm the current official page.

opportunities.name: IJCAI–ECAI 2026
opportunities.amount: Case-by-case IJCAI–AIJ travel grant; EurAI also offered €400 grants to eligible student members
coverage: Travel/attendance expenses reimbursed up to the awarded amount
Eligible expenses must be documented with receipts
Additional EurAI support was available to qualifying student members
notCovered: Award amount is not guaranteed in advance
Applicant is asked to seek department/local AI-society support first
opportunities.graduateEligibility: Graduate students are eligible under the conference's general student grant program; a support letter from the advisor/head of department is required for students.
opportunities.paperRequirement: NO accepted paper is required. If applications exceed available funds, applicants with an accepted technical paper receive preference, followed by other active conference participants.
opportunities.recurWatch: Future European IJCAI/ECAI editions should be checked when announced.
opportunities.note: Premier international AI conference. 2026 was held in Germany.

opportunities.name: ECML PKDD 2026
coverage: Award may be lower than the requested amount depending on budget and circumstances
notCovered: The public support page does not specify an exact expense-by-expense coverage list
opportunities.graduateEligibility: The conference explicitly supports students who may otherwise be unable to attend. Graduate students are included in this student category.
opportunities.paperRequirement: The support page does NOT state that an accepted paper is required. Scientific-program participation is one evaluation factor, together with academic motivation, financial need, geographical diversity, and application quality.
opportunities.recurWatch: ECML PKDD 2027 is announced for Eindhoven, Netherlands. Watch for the 2027 student-support call.
opportunities.note: Flagship European machine-learning and data-mining conference.

opportunities.name: ECML PKDD 2027 — Funding Watch
coverage: 2027 student-support details are not yet posted
The 2026 edition offered up to €1,000 per student
opportunities.graduateEligibility: 2027 eligibility is TBD. The 2026 program supported students generally, which included graduate students.
opportunities.paperRequirement: 2027 rule is TBD. In 2026, accepted-paper authorship was not stated as a requirement.
opportunities.recurWatch: Automatic tracker should look for a 2027 scholarship/student-support page and application deadline.
opportunities.note: 2027 conference is officially announced in the Netherlands; funding call has not yet been posted.

opportunities.name: AIxIA 2026
opportunities.amount: €400 discount on the conference registration fee
opportunities.graduateEligibility: Master's and PhD students are explicitly eligible; applicants must also be AIxIA members for the second half of 2026.
opportunities.paperRequirement: NO accepted paper is required. Accepted Doctoral Consortium, conference, or workshop contributions are evaluation criteria, but they are not listed as eligibility requirements.
opportunities.recurWatch: Watch future AIxIA editions for student-grant calls.
opportunities.note: Italian AI conference; grant deadline has passed although the conference is still upcoming.

opportunities.name: PASC26
opportunities.amount: Up to $800 from within Europe or $1,600 from another continent, plus conference registration
coverage: Travel reimbursement up to $800 for students traveling from within Europe
Travel reimbursement up to $1,600 for students traveling from another continent
opportunities.graduateEligibility: Graduate students enrolled at an accredited university in any country are eligible; SIGHPC membership is required.
opportunities.paperRequirement: NO accepted contribution is required. PASC/SIGHPC states that students who submitted a contribution are favored, but submission is not a requirement of the award.
opportunities.recurWatch: PASC student travel grants recur; watch the next European edition.
opportunities.note: Not a pure ML conference, but directly relevant to ML/HPC/scientific-computing research.
